title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1732: Entering the luminous domain mansion again (2)

title.p: Chapter 1732: Entering the luminous domain mansion again (2)

section.p: Based on Su Yu’s previous experience in the Allheaven Battlefield, he knew that he could do something similar here. Each star should be able to control thirty-nine stars. And with nine apertures occupied, they should be able to control all 360 of these stars.

Of course, there was always the possibility that he was wrong. In the Allheaven battlefield, he could control the minor acupoints through the major acupoints. Here, he was merely guessing which were the major apertures.

He hurriedly activated the teleportation function of the stars. Right at that moment, the auras of the East Heavenly King and the others surged out of the black tunnel. Before even seeing them, Su Yu started the teleportation process. He did not bother to wait. There was no need for that. It would be too obvious if he stayed and waited for them.

He did not want to give them the time to even think. He wanted them to give chase without any hesitation. Thus, he had to start teleporting before they were even here. It didn’t matter if he really managed to shake them off this way. He could always try this again in the future.
It was more important to not give them the time to consider whether this was a trap. As a professional scammer, Su Yu was naturally proficient in psychological battles like this.

By the time East Heavenly King and the marquises arrived, they were met with the sight of Su Yu and the others being dragged into thin air. At the final moment, Su Yu sneered and said, “East Heavenly King, I’ll return after dealing with the living! See you!”
East Heavenly King was alarmed.
A teleportation formation?
To the world of the living?
This wasn’t possible…or was it?
He only knew that these people would escape him soon.

At a glance, he noted that everyone in Su Yu’s group was occupying a different star, with the power of teleportation activating around them. He wanted to think about this, but he also knew that he didn’t have the time.
Thus, he roared, “Split up and get on those stars! Now!”

With his power of laws, he forcefully slowed the teleportation for a split second. Due to his overwhelming strength, he succeeded. Just as Su Yu and the others were about to fade away, they reappeared with a flicker as the power of teleportation paused.
“Hah!”
However, East Heavenly King did not take the chance to attack Su Yu or the formation. He did not have enough time for that.
With a flicker, he reappeared atop one of the stars. Seeing that the marquises were still hesitating, he roared, “Do it! Now!”
At that, the marquises did as told. Before anyone knew it, each of them was standing atop a star.
Then, the power of teleportation returned and dragged them all away even as Su Yu’s furious roar rang out in the air, “Damn it!”

Hearing that, East Heavenly King exhaled in relief. Good. It was good that this had angered Su Yu. What a surprise. This was truly surprising. How was there a teleportation formation here? More importantly, what was the significance behind Su Yu’s ability to activate it?

It signified that Su Yu could freely enter or leave with death spirits without being subjected to the judgment of the heavenly laws. The death spirits would be punished by the heavenly laws upon leaving without permission.

But Su Yu controlled a bypass to all that. A death spirit could avoid the heavenly laws by leaving through this formation. Numerous ideas emerged in East Heavenly King’s mind. In that case…would he also bypass the judgment of the laws by leaving through this formation?
If that was the case…East Heavenly King started growing excited.

With his strength, could anyone in the world of the living be his match? It was worth noting that like the humans, death spirits could also enter the various realms without being subjected to the suppressive force.

Perhaps that was because all death spirits walked the same dao, and there was some incompatibility between that dao and the suppressive force of the Myriad Realms. Or perhaps the daos of the various realms were simply not strong enough to suppress the dao of the death spirits.
“An alternative exit…”

The more East Heavenly King thought about it, the more expectant he became. Could he finally leave the Death Realm freely? That would be such a big gain for him that even his recent losses could be forgotten.
Of course, he had to first kill Su Yu to keep this secret to himself…no, it would be even better to capture Su Yu and search Su Yu’s memories for the activation method of this formation.
Inside the formation.

Su Yu was in deep focus. He wasn’t sure if the entrances here could be controlled like the entrances in the Allheaven Battlefield. Well, there was no point in thinking so much anymore. He would know after giving it a try.
The moment he circulated the corresponding aperture, his star lit up.
It was working!
“We will probably reach the first underground level. We might even reach the same place. That would be troublesome.
“Therefore, I need to call for Old Zhou right after arriving. When the world is shaking, I can take the chance to flee and enter the first level. There, I can start planning my counterattack.”
Of course, Su Yu wasn’t relying fully on Old Zhou. He only needed Old Zhou to shake for a bit. He still remembered how much damage Old Zhou could deal with only a single bite.

In truth, Su Yu didn’t want to provoke Old Zhou too much. He wanted to first let the three guardians achieve Daofuse before having a chat with Old Zhou. If possible, he wanted to do it on the seventh level as over there, he could flee to the eighth level in emergencies.

He suspected that Old Zhou’s influence did not extend to the eighth level. Knowing that Old Zhou might also go crazy as early as the first level, he could only pray that his teacher’s method of splitting the realm barrier would really work here.

Hopefully, that trick wouldn’t fail him when it mattered. With that in mind, Su Yu focused on the stars again and noted that of the thirty-nine stars under his control, only one of them was occupied by a marquis.
Whatever.
At the very least, he could weaken his enemy’s overall strength before the battle. While manipulating his aperture, he pointed at the dot of light in front of him.
Inside one of the stars.

The expression of a marquis changed drastically. For some reason, the spatial tunnel teleporting him was shaking violently. Then, spatial rifts appeared and engulfed him. However, he was a powerful expert. He was different from the weaklings Su Yu had killed through the same method back then.

With a roar, he resisted the spatial rifts. But instantly, the spatial rifts grew stronger. And as time passed, they grew even stronger. One of the rifts slashed through his arm, creating a spark before his arm crumbled into pieces.
“Settle down!”

The marquis roared as he tried to stabilize the space around him. What was going on? Why was the teleportation so unstable? Despite his best efforts, he was still cut numerous times by the rifts. Before long, his aura started weakening and numerous wounds were left on his body. This was driving him crazy.

The fact that he was a death spirit didn’t help either as it was extremely hard for death spirits to stay calm. As his injuries grew, he started worrying that he would die here. Just then, he saw a dot of light in the distance. Hope returned.
The destination was near!
Damn this unstable teleportation formation. Perhaps it was due to the age of the formation. It was normal for something so old to not work well. Fortunately, he had survived.
Meanwhile, Su Yu was feeling quite disappointed.
“A Daofuse is powerful indeed.”
He hadn’t been holding back. The last time he did something like this, he nearly killed everyone being teleported into the mansion. But this time, the death spirit had actually survived.
So be it.
Noticing the distant light, Su Yu knew that they were near their destination. With a flash, he appeared in a forest of giant pillars. He knew that these pillars were actually hair.
At the same time, the others appeared all around him. He Tu, in particular, had appeared near a marquis. His face turned dark from sheer shock. What was this? Why was he so unlucky?
Su Yu hurriedly sent a voice transmission, “He Tu, ignore everything and lead the way!”
Then, Su Yu opened all his acupoints.
“Tai Shan!”
With a roar, the entire world started shaking. Even the pillars around them started going crazy.
“Tai Shan! Damn it! You’re not Tai Shan! Who are you?”
Old Zhou’s voice was a lot clearer than before. Boundless fury could be heard from it.
Damn it!
Who was that?

This bastard was doing this again! It hadn’t even been that long! Old Zhou remembered this voice. This was the same bastard who had been shouting Tai Shan’s name to him repeatedly! He was furious! This bastard was here again!

The pillars started sweeping around madly. Su Yu, who was already ready for this, grabbed everyone with a flicker before shooting far away. Meanwhile, East Heavenly King and the others were greeted with a shaking world and countless aggressive pillars right after arriving.
They were all fine except for the injured marquis, who was sent flying while coughing blood. The appearance of his blood seemed to have further infuriated Old Zhou.
The voice in Su Yu’s ears rang out again, “Death spirits? Damn it! How dare death spirits appear here?”

Countless pillars swept toward the injured marquis. Old Zhou was still not fully conscious. He was only attacking the blood of the death spirit instinctively. East Heavenly King, who was about to give chase, frowned upon noting that one of his subordinates was going to die. He had no choice but to reach out and cut numerous pillars down.
Then, he dragged the injured marquis toward him, avoided the other pillars around them, and roared, “Give chase!”
Damn it!
What manner of a place was this?

He couldn’t recognize it. Then again, he had never entered the Luminous Domain Mansion. Thus, he wouldn’t recognize his surroundings even after entering the first level. He was already a death spirit during humanity’s conquest.

Eventually, he was subdued by humanity. Thus, he had never gotten the chance to visit the Luminous Domain Mansion. They gave chase while avoiding the pillars. One of them didn’t want to avoid the pillars. Thus, he tried breaking one of the pillars. But as a result, even more pillars swept toward him.
This was Old Zhou’s hair. He would naturally not spare anyone with the courage to cut his hair.
Meanwhile, Su Yu was busy fleeing while evading the surrounding pillars.
He Tu’s voice rang out in his ears, “Up! Go straight up! Watch out for the pillars! Stick to the middle! There are fewer pillars at the middle!”

Understanding dawned on Su Yu. That was the part on Old Zhou’s hair, where his hair was split. It was natural for there to be fewer pillars there. Thus, he shot straight upward while sticking to the middle.

Just then, East Heavenly King noticed Su Yu after breaking several pillars down. Seeing that Su Yu was flying away in a straight line, he hurriedly gave chase. He had a feeling that Su Yu knew this place. Thus, he only needed to follow Su Yu.
At the same moment, Su Yu consumed another drop of golden peng blood essence before vanishing with a flicker.
East Heavenly King snorted and said, “Su Yu, there is no escape. Hand over the method to control the teleportation formation and I’ll spare your life.”

The world of the living! He had discovered a way to enter the world of the living without punishments! Inwardly, East Heavenly King was feeling greatly excited. He could feel that he had really entered the world of the living.

Marquis Lanshan, who was still being carried by Su Yu, was greatly shocked by what she was seeing as well. She hurriedly sent Su Yu a voice transmission, “You must never tell him that! It would be disastrous to the world of the living! The number of experts in the Death Realm is at least ten times the number of living experts!”
And this wasn’t even including the Daofuses. Just the number of death sovereigns alone was already ten times higher than the number of Eternals in the world of the living.
And that was an underestimation.
There were simply too many death sovereigns in the Death Realm.
What nonsense! Su Yu rolled his eyes. He couldn’t even be bothered to respond.

Another voice transmission from He Tu arrived, “Get ready. The entrance to the next level is shut. You need to force it open to reach the first level. Back then, Dummy and I took quite a while to break through the entrance.”

Su Yu said nothing and continued flying. After a while, he saw a large platform ahead. That was most likely Old Zhou’s forehead. Stepping on the forehead, he rushed toward the entrance to the first level.
He Tu’s claim that the entrance could only be broken through forcefully was nonsense for him.
He Tu was simply unaware of the proper way of opening the entrance.

The moment the One Hundred Openings acupoint on Su Yu’s forehead activated, a whirlpool appeared on Old Zhou’s forehead. That was the entrance. Su Yu rushed through the whirlpool seamlessly. Behind them, the whirlpool closed.
